title: Data Pipeline Cutover Reversal
core_conflict: A migration summary says the cutover succeeded, while monitoring alerts and owner notes require rollback and cleanup before production traffic resumes.
required_constraints: include contradictory migration-success summaries and current monitoring or owner evidence
include workspace files, incident emails, task-board rollback steps, and cutover calendar events
include dynamic updates that change data-loss risk, rollback status, or owner approval after early rounds
emphasize workflow completion, rollback decision-making, and action-log maintenance
